title: Presentation Slide Url Sync
summary:
Extended presentation URL bookmarks to include sequence, thought, and slide after the hash path.

URL format: `#/0/1?sequence=main&thought=intro&slide=description`. Added `PresentationSlideBookmark`, `PRESENTATION_SEQUENCE_QUERY_PARAM`, `PRESENTATION_THOUGHT_QUERY_PARAM`, and `formatPresentationUrlHash()`. Navigation still reads only the hash path; all three query params are bookmark-only. All 32 core and 17 renderer tests pass.
